# The check accepts a workflow that reads the round settings of the rounds block from facts(), and refuses a round field that facts() does not have.
isolate

exec beehavereal check workflow ok.star
! stdout .
! stderr .

! exec beehavereal check workflow bad.star
stderr 'round_nope is not a field of the result of facts'

-- ok.star --
def main(item):
    f = facts()
    command(run = ["echo", f.round_base, f.round_owner, f.round_label] + f.round_items + f.round_base_reds + f.round_allow_paths, name = "show")
    if f.round_merge and f.round_lane_cap > 0 and f.round_fix_rounds > 0 and f.round_wait_hours >= 0 and f.round_integration_pr == 0:
        command(run = ["echo", f.round_next_base, f.round_owner_email, f.round_source_checkout, f.round_acceptance, f.round_base_result, f.round_base_reds_file, f.round_lane_kind], name = "more")
-- bad.star --
def main(item):
    f = facts()
    command(run = ["echo", f.round_nope], name = "show")
